segments.text:
V. 26.
Jeſus anſwered—In his Ear. So careful was He not to offend (if it had been poſſible) even Judas himſelf. The ſop—Which He took up while he was ſpeaking. He giveth it Iudas—And probably the other Diſciples thought Judas peculiarly happy! But when even this Inſtance of our LORD's Tenderneſs could not move him, then Satan took full Poſſeſſion.
